name: mac-messages
description: Read and send messages from macOS Messages app (iMessage/SMS). Use to get latest SMS codes (e.g. bank 2FA), search conversations, send messages. Requires Full Disk Access for Terminal/Cursor.
notes: Install: brew install uv. MCP config uses git commit dc0452a (FastMCP description fix; PyPI v0.7.3 broken). Use for: Millennium BCP SMS code — when script waits at SMS step, ask agent to read latest Messages. Repo: https://github.com/carterlasalle/mac_messages_mcp
